ValidationRule.description: Prevents resume AI processing without candidate consent.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR(ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(Candidate__c), ISCHANGED(Status__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Candidate__c)), NOT(Candidate__r.Is_Consent_Available__c), NOT( OR( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Cancelled"), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Manual Entry") ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Candidate consent is required before resume or AI processing.
